Mentre riscopre Istanbul con occhi nuovi, cominceranno anche a riaccendersi i sentimenti da tempo dimenticati. (Ohran is a Turkish novelist who left his country following a personal tragedy which made him lose his inspiration. Twenty years later, at his publisher’s request, he heads back to Istanbul to help Deniz, a successful international film director, put the finishing touches to his autobiography. But after a few days, Deniz mysteriously disappears. Ohran joins the search to track him down, along with Deniz’s family and friends, whom he has already got to know a little through his work on the book. He also rediscovers buried emotions which finally rekindle his appetite for both love and writing.)

13 MAGGIO 2016. Lo scrittore turco Orhan Sahin, stabilitosi a Londra da anni, arriva a Istanbul su invito del famoso regista Deniz Soysal per lavorare al suo libro. Deniz vive con la famiglia in un decadente palazzo sul Bosforo. Fin dal primo giorno Orhan si trova avvolto in una fitta tela di relazioni complicate e amicizie misteriose. Mentre riscopre Istanbul con occhi nuovi, cominceranno anche a riaccendersi i sentimenti da tempo dimenticati.

Ohran is a Turkish novelist who left his country following a personal tragedy which made him lose his inspiration. Twenty years later, at his publisher’s request, he heads back to Istanbul to help Deniz, a successful international film director, put the finishing touches to his autobiography. But after a few days, Deniz mysteriously disappears. Ohran joins the search to track him down, along with Deniz’s family and friends, whom he has already got to know a little through his work on the book. His investigations lead him to discover a hidden side of the both the missing director and this fabled city. He also rediscovers buried emotions which finally rekindle his appetite for both love and writing.
